 Fulton County Prepares for the Final Day of Early Voting
 October 30, 2026 
 Advance Voting for the November 3, General/Special Election ends Friday, October 30. 
 The Fulton County Department of Registration and Elections is preparing for the last day of advance voting. The early voting period for the November 3, 2026, General/Special Elections ends at 7 p.m. on Friday, October 30.
In Fulton County, more than 268,000 registered eligible voters have cast their ballot early. Fulton County is the only county in Georgia to offer 32 advance voting locations.
Those deciding to wait until Tuesday, November 3 to vote must do so only at their assigned polling location, which can be found by visiting https://mvp.sos.ga.gov/s/
For added voter convenience, 7 Advance Voting locations offer on-site absentee ballot drop boxes, and three additional Advance Voting locations are housed in the same facility as a Registrar’s Offices to accept absentee-by-mail ballots.
